title: Lifting AC units and heavy equipment
lines: A new AC unit for the roof or balcony? Don't carry it upstairs.
The crane lifts the unit straight into place.
We calculate weight and reach ahead and match the crane.
The crew above receives it, a signaller guides from below.
Fast, clean, and not a single scratch on the building.
Ofek At Tal Cranes. We handle the heavy stuff.
